result.analyst_notes: Assertive first-person plural voice with absolute framing ('no excuses', 'resolute'), organized around 'responsible growth' and growth-led purpose. Growth and clients lead, with employees and communities appearing briefly. Commitments are stated firmly, though a disclaimer calls goals aspirational. Much of the page is legal disclaimer text, which is uncoded.
